page: Microsoft Azure M128-64bs_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the MBSMediumMemoryv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8473C processor operating at 4.0 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 105 MB of L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache per core, and 48 KB of L1d cache. It is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 16.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, relying instead on external premium block storage.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate strong multi-core and memory performance. The server achieved a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 67520.07 and a PassMark CPU score of 81783.6. Memory bandwidth is highly competitive, reaching top-tier speeds of 365.6 GB/sec for large-block read-only operations and 173.16 GB/sec for large-block write operations. Database operations are a key strength, with PassMark database benchmarks scoring in the top tier at 35206.66 and Redis SET operations reaching 87.51 million operations per second. Single-core performance is moderate, with a stress-ng single-core score of 2059.49.

The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512, Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_tile and AMX_int8) for accelerated matrix operations, and cryptography standards like VAES and SHA_NI. These hardware features translate to strong performance in specialized tasks, such as Geekbench image processing (19247.0, top tier) and LLM inference, where it processes 238.13 tokens per second for a medium 7B model prompt. Given its massive memory capacity, high memory bandwidth, and strong database performance, this server is optimized for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and memory-intensive data processing workloads.
